opis: The sunny race meadow from the reference picture, with its start: two wooden posts with colourful bunting. On the grass a white chalk START line runs across the picture, and behind it, side by side, four little animals crouch ready to run, all facing RIGHT: a big grey BUNNY with long ears, a small round brown HEDGEHOG, a fluffy yellow DUCKLING and a tiny grey MOUSE. The OWL stands at the end of the line and raises a small red flag high in one wing, about to wave it. In front on the left the MOLE hops with excitement and cheers; on the right the BEAVER holds a little camera to his eye, ready to take a photo. Bright, sunny, full of excitement.
